resources.string: Uses LINE accessibility content only to locate and visually mask the promotional banner in Chats and the final three bottom tabs. No data is stored or transmitted.
Masks the LINE VOOM promotional banner shown between Search and your first chat, plus the final three bottom tabs. It supports both the original and redesigned LINE layouts.
Accessibility access is used only to find and mask these areas while LINE is on screen. No content or personal data is stored or transmitted.
LINE is not installed or cannot be opened.
